opening.argument: The video presents a routine Uber walkthrough centered on an ordinary first-use promotion. It explains that Uber provides promo codes, offers a first ride free up to $20, and shows the viewer how to download the app, enter the code, select a vehicle, estimate a fare, and request an UberX ride. The instructions are tied to using Uber's own service, not to an investment, credential request, or money-transfer solicitation. The available evidence describes no deceptive conduct, required payment to the speaker, harmful destination, or claimed loss. This is a conventional promotional benefit accompanied by practical instructions for completing a ride request.

citations.quote: So a great thing that Uber does is that they give out promo codes.
it'll give you your first ride for free up to $20
the first thing you want to do is actually download it
